sentences.text: No: clause 9.3 requires a pre-payment charge of 3% of the principal outstanding on foreclosure or pre-payment, but the applicable UCB rule finding says pre-payment charge is not applicable for this case.

The older RBI pre-payment-charge directions cited in the record were withdrawn or repealed and are no longer in force on the as-of date, while the current UCB directions are the applicable rule set here.
